from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,time,datetime
repo=Path.cwd()
sys.path[:0]=[str(repo/'.agents/skills/monitor-tune-isaaclab-training/scripts'),str(repo/'scripts/reinforcement_learning/rsl_rl')]
import run_evaluation_batch as batch
from evidence_provenance import write_bytes,encode
root=repo/'learnings/policy_tuning/RobotLab-Isaac-BeyondMimic-Flat-LW-wheel-v0/2026-11-09_12-58-20'
training=root/'evidence/training'
contract=json.loads((training/'evaluation-request-20261110-001.json').read_text())
original_seal=batch.seal_batch
def execute(argv,console,timeout):
    return batch.run_process(argv+['--kit_args=--/app/settings/persistent=false'],console,timeout)
def seal_with_review(run,batch_id,cases,**kwargs):
    derived=run/'evaluations'/batch_id/'derived'
    derived.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    write_bytes(derived/'cases-ready.json',encode({'cases':cases,'ready_at':datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()}))
    print('CASES_READY_FOR_OFFLINE_ANALYSIS',flush=True)
    report_input=derived/'report-input.json'
    deadline=time.monotonic()+1800
    while not report_input.exists():
        if time.monotonic()>deadline:
            raise TimeoutError('Offline analysis was not supplied within 1800 seconds; raw cases retained unsealed.')
        time.sleep(1)
    review=json.loads(report_input.read_text())
    kwargs.update(notes=review['notes'],supporting=[Path(p) for p in review['supporting']]+[report_input],recommendations=review['recommendations'])
    return original_seal(run,batch_id,cases,**kwargs)
batch.seal_batch=seal_with_review
result=batch.run_batch(contract,execute=execute)
write_bytes(training/'evaluation-execution-20261110-001.json',encode(result))
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
purpose: Run the finite standard batch; protect Kit persistent settings and seal the single report after offline analysis.
